ns2:course.label: Health and Society
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in Health & Wellness. Engages the social dimensions of Health & Wellness from an interdisciplinary perspective and emphasizes experiential learning through projects, design-based thinking, community-engaged scholarship or field-trips. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Health/Well, and Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
